_readme: The job radar (scripts/radar) reads your resume PDF for your skills, so you rarely need to edit this. 'have' = extra skills added on top of the resume's (ones it implies without naming, e.g. Backend, System Design). 'want' = skills you want to grow into (counted as a partial match, shown as a blue 'grow' chip). Names are matched case-insensitively against each opening's FULL job description. Known skills (Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, GenAI, ...) use smart aliases automatically (e.g. 'Kubernetes' also matches 'k8s'); any other name you add is matched literally. The next daily radar run re-scores with your changes.
